lines.x: S&P affirmed Poland's rating while revising its outlook due to budget deficit concerns, whereas Morningstar DBRS downgraded its credit rating, noting that economic growth is insufficient to halt public finance deterioration.
S&P Global's decision to lower Poland's rating outlook serves as a warning on the necessity to stabilize unsustainable public finances, according to PKO BP economists.
Standard & Poor's revised Poland's credit outlook to negative, with officials blaming ongoing presidential vetoes.
Poland's parliament passed statutory measures introducing 2027 tax reform provisions, rules for short-term rentals, salary limits for doctors, and higher base pay for junior teachers.
